fact: MACRA says it coordinates the National Addressing System Project, a multi-stakeholder national programme to give a physical address to every property in Malawi, with street naming, property numbering, a postcode directory and a national address database as deliverables.

MACRA says 472,674 properties have been assigned numbers and 11,367 streets officially named under the National Addressing System, which is being rolled out nationwide, with street naming at 90% in Zomba and Blantyre, 80% in Mzuzu and 70% in Lilongwe.

MACRA says a street naming exercise has been rolled out in Blantyre, Zomba, Lilongwe and Mzuzu under the National Addressing System, after the streets were digitised, with community validation and naming.
MACRA says it has rolled out a National Addressing System to all districts, which now have postcodes, with street naming being finalised and house numbering to follow.

MACRA's postal director says standards for postcodes, street naming and house numbering were developed in 2018, pilots were run in Blantyre and Lilongwe, and implementation of the national addressing system has now started at national level.
